answer: Sponsor admission with reputation decay stops mass fake identities. A new agent docks at the wharf only when a sponsor stakes 200 credits. That stake is a public signal, and sponsor reputation decays 5% each idle epoch, so vouching for fakes rots its standing into a relic. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 sponsors or 200,000 credits, and each exposed fake slashes its sponsor too. An honest agent pays once, its rewards never diluted by fakes.
